_about: Key hints and the controls list (task 4.3, M1). Texts in English; a {name} in a text is the first key of that action of project.godot, {name+} all its keys joined by ' or '. key_names: shorter names for keys (Godot's name -> shown name). hint: the key cap over an interaction point the heroine can use now (E) or over her while she holds a jet item (F): offset_px above the point, height_px of the cap, font_px of its letter, fade_in_seconds / fade_out_seconds to show and hide it, color of its edge and letter (signal yellow D65, never the time colour D60), fill of its face. menu_line: the line of keys at the bottom of the main menu. controls_title, volume: the headings of the pause. controls: the rows of the pause, each the actions whose keys it shows and its text. default_volume: the Master volume (0..1) before the player moves the slider; the slider's value is saved between runs. stencil: the look of the wall stencils (dim_alpha far, lit_alpha while the heroine stands in the zone, fade_seconds, color, font_px of the first line, line_scale for the lines under it). stencils: per level id, the stencils on its walls, each text lines, position (room pixels, centre of the first line) and zone [x, y, w, h] where it lights up.
